notes.title: Release date set! Blackfaun Patch 0.9.1
notes.notes:
Blackfaun patch 0.9.1 is now live! Check out the full patch notes below:

GENERAL

Release! We’re excited to announce that Blackfaun will move to full retail release on October, 26th! Tell your friends! ːsteamhappyː
Massive thanks to all of our Early Access supporters, we couldn't have done it without you!


OTHER

Lowered the amount of orbs that Genesis spawns to be relative to his current hit points.
Raised the Faun’s base projectile speed.
Reduced the projectile speed of the Withered Effigy.
Increased the damage over time effect on the Toxic Rod.
Increased the radius of the Mana Burst slightly.
Removed the ability to activate the Sprint ability while channeling a beam weapon.
Increased player starting health on Easy and Normal modes.
Added a delay to the portal activation after defeating a boss in the Duskhaven Sanctuary.


BUG FIXES

Fixed an issue that prevented Dacian’s Spyglass from detecting if it scored a hit or not.
Fixed an issue preventing some animations from playing in the recap screen.
Fixed an issue that sometimes caused the game to crash when fighting Elora.
Fixed an issue that prevented the game from remembering screen resolution and fullscreen settings.
Removed controller prompts when playing with the keyboard and mouse.
Adjusted Lyrewolf pathing to fix some miscellaneous issues.
Fixed some environment collider objects in Lyrewood Vale.
Fixed Goblin Totem projectile height.
Fixed an issue that caused some Court of Thorns map tiles to spawn improperly.
Fixed some issues that prevented the game from reloading when using “Play again” after death.
Fixed an issue that sometimes caused the game to crash when opening a golden chest.
Fixed an issue that sometimes caused the game to crash when encountering the Relic Guardian.
Fixed an issue that sometimes caused the game to crash when encountering Lai’ruhn Maga.
Increased performance overall on all platforms.
Fixed an issue with texture loading on the Mac platform.
Fixed an issue that caused the Artemis Parry Mana Burst to be too close to the player.
Cleaned up Iron Phantasm’s animations.
Cleaned up Genesis, Pestilence, Dread, and Wonder animations.
Cleaned up the Faun’s boss dialog animations.
Fixed an issue that allowed the player to attack a boss during boss conversations.
Fixed an issue where certain UI effects would improperly play during the loading sequence.
Fixed an issue with Pan’s starting weapon hitting offscreen enemies.

notes.title: Blackfaun patch 0.9.0 is now live -- Controller support and a new tileset!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, we’re back with our final tileset and controller support! We apologize for the length of time between updates. The Court of thorns took us longer than expected, but hopefully the amount of content makes up for the delay. Thanks for all of your support!


Blackfaun patch 0.9.0 is now live -- check out the full patch notes below:


http://www.blackfaungame.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/palace_BG_01_resize.png


http://www.blackfaungame.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/General_Cen.gif

Act 4: The Court of Thorns has been added to the game! Eri corners Pan in their once tranquil birthplace as we finish the story of Blackfaun in this final chapter!
Four new bosses and six new enemies now plot your doom within these royal halls. Each enemy comes with a chance to drop a new talisman for your collection.
Controller support Woohoo! Blackfaun is now compatible with XBox and PS4 controllers! Additionally, we’ve updated the UI and other game actions to be compatible with controllers. Give us your feedback on the boards.
Instruction Page We’ve added a set of instructions and gameplay explanations to the main menu page under “Tutorial”.



http://www.blackfaungame.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/Bosses_H.gif

Censha, the Red Spear

Stay away from the pointy end.


Zoma and Knemid, Harpy Matriarchs

Two for the price of one.


Orlith, Rider of Dread

Let’s buuuuurn.


Ugark, the Thunderous Hoof

Savage metal riffs and face melting.




http://www.blackfaungame.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/Enemies_LM3.gif

Palace Tiger
Ingot Devil
Lai'ruhn Maga
Lai'ruhn Incubus
Stone Simulacrum
Crystal Siren



http://www.blackfaungame.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/Other_Inc.gif

Cleaned up boss dialog sequences.
Added a warning message when starting a new game while there is another play-through in progress.
Exalted Wisp ring now increases AOE damage from destroying wisps.
Added explosion visual effects to all familiars’ attacks.
Windowed mode now resizes the game window by default.
Reduced screenshake caused by the Wise Master weapon.



BUG FIXES

Fixed an issue that allowed the Withered Effigy to shoot through walls.
Fixed an issue that prevented Pan from blinking while the Bat’s Tongue offhand was equipped.
Fixed an issue that allowed Pan to sometimes blink through doors.
Fixed an issue that prevented enemies from aggroing while the Shadow Guide chest was equipped.
Fixed an issue that sometimes allowed the Goblin Totem to continue shooting even after it was destroyed.
Fixed an animation issue with Lyrewolves.
Fixed an issue that allowed Pan to continue to attack while affected by silence.
Fixed that issue that sometimes caused the game to crash during the loading screen.


Note: All local save data has been reset with this patch release for stability issues. Thanks for bearing with us for this reset.

notes.title: Blackfaun patch 0.8.6 is now live! New playable character!
notes.notes:
Blackfaun patch 0.8.6 is now live! Check out the full patch notes below:

http://www.blackfaungame.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/minimap_icon_header.png

GENERAL

Pan has been added to the game as a playable character! He begins his adventure with an alternate set of abilities:

Beam attack - Pan’s starting weapon releases a beam of energy at his foes. The beam does low damage, but has a fast cooldown.
http://www.blackfaungame.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/pan_beam3.png

Burst-blink - Pan’s offhand Manaburst comes with a blink, teleporting him in a short distance in the direction of the mouse cursor(mouse) or facing direction(gamepad).
http://www.blackfaungame.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/pan_blink3.png

Candles of madness - when Pan uses a candle, instead of becoming ethereal, he gains a boost to his attack speed and damage for the duration. Pan’s candles still detect secret doors in the same way that the faun’s do.
http://www.blackfaungame.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/Pan_candle3.png

Unlockable Content - Note that Pan will be an unlockable character at final release. However, he will be available to all players for most of the remaining Early Access period regardless of whether or not said unlock conditions have been met. 


http://www.blackfaungame.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/Pan_Idleflop_04.gif
BUG FIXES

Fixed an issue causing too many consumables to drop when defeating enemies.
Fixed a miscellaneous issue causing map generation issues in Lyrewood Vale.
Tweaked some hallway and room wall colliders in Lyrewood Vale.
Fixed an issue with the Sewer Crab getting stuck in certain parts of rooms.
Fixed an issue with looping sounds not ending properly when defeating enemies.

notes.title: Item Pack #2 (patch 0.8.4)
notes.notes:
Blackfaun item pack #2 (patch 0.8.4) is now live! Check out the full patch notes below:

GENERAL

We’re releasing our second item pack!


http://www.blackfaungame.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/item-patch-2b.png


ITEMS

Piercing Gaze

Special ability: Your familiar’s attacks have a chance to fear enemies.
Description: “Warriors, berserkers, and rangers from across the Second Kingdom would enlist to hunt any who managed to capture the relic from The Watchers. The emotionless Trackers would wear these cowls for their intimidating presence. Today, the hoods still retain their powerful properties.” — History of the Second Kingdom, page 1108


Dampening Cowl

Special ability: Your familiar  gains an aura that slows nearby enemies.
Description: “Before the great golem was created to guard The Relic, magisters, arbiters, and adjudicators from across the Second Kingdom would volunteer to safeguard its power. The enlisted Watchers would wear these cowls for their powerful warding properties. Today, the cowls still retain their dampening capabilities.” — History of the Second Kingdom, page 1108


Hurricane Lamp

Special ability: Your mana burst pushes enemies much further.
Description: A blessing from the wind goddess bestowed upon her most devout followers. Shelter for all who walk in the Gale Maiden’s wake.


Untethered Beacon

Special ability: Your mana burst has unlimited range.
Description: “OWW!!! Deerlegs far but grunts run fast!”
“What if smaller chop-choppers let us run faster?”
“Smaller chop-choppers? I chop-chop you instead!”
— Greld, Stoneblade Captain


Tiger-hide Wrap

Special ability: Grants immunity to critical strikes.
Description: “The Red Spear’s garb. The leathers sharpen her senses while blunting any opposition as she strides effortlessly through combat. Her deadly grace is unmatched.”  — Herrena, Greenwind Seraph


Shellskin Trappings

Special ability: Gains physical resistance whenever the wearer is damaged.
Description: This mantle of shells adapts to its surroundings, hardening slightly each time a blade grazes its surface.


Horizon Stone

Special ability: When you use a candle, all enemies lose 50% health.
Description: Another product of the palatial workshops. Horizon Stones were crafted by exposing metal spheres to candle flames for long periods. Rather than blacken, the stones would gain a transparent quality from the delicate flames. Once fully forged, the Horizon Stones can react with nearby candle flames to create a brilliant flash of flame.


Exalted Wisp

Special ability: All wisp bonuses are maximized and ancient wisp bonuses are doubled.
Description: The wisps are the bonds that hold Inun together. Together, they radiate all of the ambient magic found on Inun. A delicate network of energy that has ever so gradually increased in magnitude, their power has been harnessed and molded over the years by its inhabitants.


Tyrant’s Mace

Special ability: Chance on hit to stun enemies.
Description: “My fist is to grapes, as my mace is to skulls.” — Mlirzog II, Blacktread Giant

notes.title: Blackfaun patch 0.8.3 is now live!
notes.notes:
Blackfaun patch 0.8.3 is now live! Check out the full patch notes below:

GENERAL

  In preparation for the Court of Thorns tileset, the number of stages per act has been reduced from 3 to 2. The purposed for this change is to condense the play experience into a tighter package. This will help differentiate playthroughs and items (and to a lesser extent enemies and bosses) will be seen less frequently.

  Enemies and bosses appearing in the second stage of each act now have increased HP to help balance the difficulty curve.

  The leveling system has been revamped: The skill points you get when leveling up will now increase base damage, luck, and max HP instead of adding to your base stats. Leveling up no longer automatically grants base damage and HP. To compensate for the lack of stats on level up, items have had their stat values increased. Additionally, ancient wisps still grant a passive boost to their corresponding stat color, their stat boost values have been tweaked to accommodate the new level up stats.

  The reasoning for these changes was to give players a different method of guiding their gameplay while giving players more meaningful and impactful choices. We felt that the previous stat system was ultimately fighting for the same spotlight as items. What do you think of these changes? Let us know in the discussions!

  Wisps now explode when impacted by player projectiles, dealing damage to everything around them -- even the player! (except on easy difficulty). They can also be mana bursted into enemies, giving the player more strategic choices in battle.


BOSSES

Relic Guardian

Now always spawns on 3-3 and triggers a new scripted sequence.
The Relic altar has been added to the Relic Guardian’s chamber. ːsteammockingː



ITEMS

Rune Egg Wand

Decreased familiar spawn chance.


Rainbow Wand

Increased base explosion radius.


Withered Effigy

Decreased curse (stat drain) debuff amount.



OTHER

Sound effects have received significant upgrades across the board. Overall sound effect experience should be enhanced!
Stoneblade Grunts have traded spots with Dreamsnatchers in the encounter order in Lyrewood Vale. Players will now encounter Stoneblade Grunts on 1-1 and Dreamsnatchers on 1-2.
An indicator has been added to the main menu screen when one or more new talismans have been unlocked.


BUG FIXES

Fixed an issue causing Stonebeak’s health regeneration effects to work improperly.
Cleaned up the way that talismans were spawning.
Fixed key consumable collection radius.
Fixed an issue which sometimes caused enemies to affect one another with their spells.
Fixed a rare issue that caused enemies to float above the player.

notes.title: Act3: Temple Depths (patch 0.8.1)
notes.notes:
Blackfaun patch 0.8.1 is now live -- featuring 50% more content! Check out the full patch notes below:

http://www.blackfaungame.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/Temple_Depths_header_image_02.png
GENERAL

Act 3: Temple Depths has been added to the game! Eri is hot on Pan’s trail as she scampers through the darkness. Find out what secrets await her as you page through the penultimate chapter of Blackfaun!
Four new bosses and six new enemies now plot your doom within the murky ‘Depths. They’re all hoarding shiny new talismans that they don’t want you to have.
Get acquainted with the new content -- check out the spotlight video:

https://youtu.be/BGwIkMziQ7A



BOSSES

Stonebeak, Hydra Baron

This is one hot lizard. Feel the burn. ːsteamhappyː


Wauna, Ickwater Matron

You’re damned if you voodoo, you’re damned if you voo-don’t.


Sezgar, Rider of Pestilence

Hope you got your seasonal flu shots!


Relic Guardian

At last, the relic chamber -- just one more pile of rocks standing in your way. Can you taste the power?



http://www.blackfaungame.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/beast_text_image_06.png

BUG FIXES

Fixed an issue causing players to get stuck on chests when they spawned.
Fixed an issue preventing Boulderscale from re-appearing after burrowing.
Fixed an issue causing the “Random” talisman selection to only populate the first talisman slot.
Fixed an issue causing scenery to be misplaced within the Duskhaven Sanctuary boss rooms.
Fixed an issue causing chests of valor to be replaced by regular chests when spawning.
Fixed an issue that prevented beam weapons from properly hitting enemies while the player was stationary.
Fixed an issue that allowed certain enemies to be permanently feared.
Cleaned up Goblin Totem fireball hitboxes.
Fixed an issue preventing Dacian’s Spyglass from interacting properly with boss Manaburst vulnerabilities.
Fixed a rare issue causing map generation errors in the player spawn area.
Fixed an issues causing achievement reward item frames to display improperly.
Fixed an issue causing negative stats to display with two hyphens in the player inventory window.
Cleaned up the hitboxes of consumables.
Fixed an issue preventing the Monarch Wand mesh from despawning when unequipped.


http://www.blackfaungame.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/crab_run_banner2.gif

Blackfaun patch 0.7.37 is now live! Check out the full patch notes below:

GENERAL

As part of our continued effort to increase the overall difficulty of the game, we’ve modified some additional boss mechanics and AI.


BOSSES

Braald, the Wolflord

Now alternates between using his charging attack and ranged attack more frequently.
Projectiles now lead the player and travel faster.
Increased Ancient Wolf health.


Boulderscale, the Hungering Wurm

Increased scale overall - body whip attack now covers a greater area.
Increased movement speed while using burrow attack.
Acid spit travels faster and now has a lower trajectory.


Arugir, Rider of Genesis

Ranged attack now spawns three projectiles, up from one.
Increased frequency of charge attack.
Summons more orbs per cast.


Aleog, Rider of Wonder

Ranged attack now spawns three projectiles, up from one.
Increased the amount of time slow bubbles on each time-slow omnicast.
Increased the amount of glyphs created with each glyph omnicast.


Moonfeather, the Last Hippogryph

Projectiles now lead the player, travel faster, and are larger.
Wind clones now fly faster and with less delay.



OTHER

Sprint now gives you a boost in speed for every mana consumed during the sprint.


Note: We are still investigating door related issues caused by Blind Shriekers in the Duskhaven Sanctuary. ːsteamfacepalmː

notes.title: Patch 0.7.33
notes.notes:
Blackfaun patch 0.7.33 is now live! Check out the full patch notes below:

GENERAL

Overall difficulty increase: We’ve heard from many that the game could be more challenging. We’ve made changes across the board to offer players a greater challenge. Judicious use of your mana burst and candles will now be essential on the hardest difficulties.


Doors now lock when the player enters a room until all enemies have been cleared.
Enemy AI has been greatly improved. Enemies are now smarter and deadlier.
Enemy spawn rate has been increased.
Boss rooms are now 3x3, down from 4x4.
Increased tower spawn rates in all environments.



Faster game flow: Getting from room to room, especially when backtracking was taking too long. We’ve made a number of changes to make the action more intense, including reducing room size and corridor length.

Ancient wisps: We’ve replaced treasure chests that grant random HP and stat bonuses (“empty chests”) with ancient wisps. There are 3 types of ancient wisps, VIT, INT, and AGI, one for each stat type indicated by matched colors. When the player collects an Ancient Wisp it will grant a stat bonus of the corresponding type and an HP boost. In addition, there is a chance that a treasure chest will drop upon collection.

Bug fixes:

Fixed an issue causing a console error when continuing a game after death.
Fixed an issue that was preventing the Boulderscale, the Hungering Wurm sprite from showing up properly on the recap screen.
Fixed an issue causing a console error when Pan is hit with a projectile.
Fixed an issue causing the vendor to sometimes sell chests that contain consumables which would cost additional gold to pick up.
Bosses now always spawn chests that contain equipment.
Various tooltips and stat calculations were fixed to display the proper values.



ENEMIES

Wolfwarden

Traps: Wolfwarden AI has been modified so that traps are only placed while far from the player. Trap size increased to help visibility. Trap poison damage no longer ignores shield hearts.


Lyrewolf

Fear: Lyrewolves can now only be affected by fear (when another enemy dies) up to one time.


Warbrute

Frenzy: Warbrutes can no longer be interrupted while casting frenzy. Increased the bonuses of the frenzy buff.


Dreamsnatcher

Darkness Pool: Now prevents the player from attacking and casting mana burst while under the effects of darkness.
Increased projectile speed. Projectiles now have a chance to lead the player.


Hexbrewer

Ranged attacks now lead the player, but are slightly less accurate.
No longer flees when the player is too near.


Iron Phantasm

Ethereal Charge now leads the player.
Increased movement speed.


Lost Soul

Increased scale.
Mana bursts now deal a large amount of damage to Lost Souls.


Duskhaven Wraith

Projectile size and speed increased.
Soul Leash: In addition to dealing damage when the player gets too far away, it now damages after a set amount of time has passed.


Spirit Elk

Spirit Cluster now charges up in 3 seconds, down from 5.
Cervine Vengeance (counterattack aura) now has a cooldown of .8 seconds, down from 1 second.
Lex and other familiars no longer trigger Cervine Vengeance.



BOSSES

Gemini Beasts

Ranged beast now leads the player.
Increased the effect of the frenzy buff.


Elora, Vileweed Monarch

Can no longer be interrupted while channeling projectile rings.
Spawns explosive (red) flower pods more often.
Flower pods are larger and have been tweaked to be more visible.



ITEMS

Daire’s Parry

Fixed an issue causing a console error when the player takes damage while a parry charge is active.


Demon Eye

Cleaned up animation timing.
